text:
alex: Heads up 1: spotted multiple mismatch points in the migration guide when moving from v1 -> v2: error payload shape changed, retry semantics for 429, and a couple of model-alias examples reference the old naming. Need a short coordinated docs sprint.
rachel: Thanks. Where are the errors documented today? I found examples in docs/migration/errors.md and snippets under examples/error-handling/js.md.
patrick: I'll own the examples repo PRs. Plan: update JS/TS snippets, add a tiny helper to normalize both shapes, and include a unit test. Opening draft PR in a bit.
emma: I'll update the migration guide text. Proposal: add a small compatibility section showing both the native v2 envelope and a one-liner shim users can paste. Also add a callout for the hosted shim timeline.
alex: Key pieces to call out in the migration checklist: 1) Error envelope: v2 uses { error: { type, message, param } } vs v1 flat message. 2) Retry header: v2 uses Retry-After (seconds) not the older X-Rate-Limit hint. 3) Model alias swap: examples that use alias "embedding-1" need to become "emb-001" in our catalog.
rachel: For the JS snippet, let's recommend this small helper so people don't accidentally read only err.message and miss the real msg. Also show a short curl example for server-side handling.
patrick: Draft snippet in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/910 (WIP). Snippet: ```js
function extractError(err) {
  const body = err?.response?.data || err
  return {
    message: body?.error?.message || body?.message || String(err),
    code: body?.error?.type || body?.code || 'unknown',
    param: body?.error?.param || null
  }
}
```
emma: Perfect. I'll add a tiny curl example: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{}' \\n  | jq -r '.error.message // .message'
```
dev-tools-bot: Created docs-card #789 on docs-board and assigned: emma (owner), patrick (examples), rachel (migration text). Reminder: due 3 days.
rachel: One more thing 1: the hosted API will run a v1 compatibility shim for 14 days after docs go live. We should mention that behavior explicitly so integrators know to expect both shapes. emma: noted, will add a brief table under "Compatibility" with timeline and recommended client change windows.
alex: Also call out that the SDK will log a deprecation warning for any call that uses v1 model aliases and recommend the alias-mapping table.
patrick: Putting tests on the PR that assert normalized error object for both mocked v1 and v2 responses. Will add a tiny README note for maintainers.
emma: After PRs merge, I'll update the migration checklist doc and add a short Slack announcement draft for #announcements. Could we also add a docs-bounty for community reviewers?
dev-tools-bot: Added bounty tag and pinged @community-docs.
rachel: Timeline: get PRs in by EOD Mon, reviews Tue, merge Wed so we can publish Thursday morning. If anyone needs help with wording I can copy-edit.
alex: Thanks all. This should prevent the spike in support tickets we saw last swap. Emoji reaction: :shield: — closing until PRs land.
patrick: Will ping when CI green.
emma: Will draft the announcement after merge and tag legal for the deprecation wording check.
